suggested_activities: 5-minute box breathing at your desk before starting work: Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 4 seconds, and hold again for 4 seconds. Repeat this cycle five times.
10-minute mindful walking break: Step outside during lunch or a break and focus on the sensation of your feet touching the ground. Notice the sounds around you without judgment.

15-minute evening gratitude journaling session: Spend time writing down three things you are grateful for that day along with why they made you feel good. Use a dedicated notebook to reflect on these positive moments.
ai_summary: This personalized plan includes short mindfulness practices throughout the day to reduce stress levels effectively.

suggested_activities: Every morning at 8:00 AM, spend 10 minutes doing the 4-7-8 breathing technique. Inhale through your nose for a count of 4, hold for a count of 7, and exhale through your mouth for a count of 8. Repeat this cycle until the time is up.

During lunch break, take a 15-minute mindful walking session outside. Focus on each step you take, the sensation of your feet touching the ground, and the sounds around you. Avoid distractions such as phone notifications.
Before bed at 9:30 PM, write down three things that went well during the day in a dedicated mindfulness journal. Spend five minutes reflecting on why they happened and how they made you feel.
ai_summary: This two-week plan incorporates specific breathing techniques, mindful movement outdoors during breaks to enhance focus, and reflective journaling before sleep to help reduce anxiety effectively.
